column1: # Transcribed bodies: name, recovered VA, the symbol the candidate defines, and the
# body's exact instruction count. verify_bodies.py resolves the symbol in
# ZolikaPatch.map and sweeps that many instructions linearly on both sides, so a
# row is a whole-body proof; a short decode on either side fails the row.
# The native-script call layer (source/native.ixx). Its two SEH entries,
# sub_100038E0 (59 instructions) and sub_10003980 (52), are compiler output for a
# C function with __try/__except and are rebuilt rather than transcribed; their
# frames name image-specific handler addresses and cannot be compared this way.
# DrivebyFOVFix (source/misc.ixx): the shim and the FOV helper it calls. The helper
# calls the native layer's resolve entry instead of the original's sub_10003980;
# the proof compares a call as an immediate, so the body is whole.
# BadPlayerModelCrashFix (source/stability.ixx): the site's trampoline, the payload
# it calls, the two native wrappers of its GTAC.dll diagnostic and the one-argument
# wrapper its fallback calls. The wrappers' shared pieces (sub_100038C0/DE40/DE80,
# sub_1005B150, sub_10003E50, sub_100038E0) are transcribed in source/native.ixx and
# source/shared.ixx and proved by their own rows above; the model-name lookup
